newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Liberty Life ends dispute with LOA.
newsitem.headline: Liberty Life ends dispute with LOA.

text.p: South Africa's Liberty Life Asssociation of Africa Ltd and the Life Offices' Association (LOA) have resolved their dispute over commission payments to brokers, the industry body said on Tuesday.

LOA chairman Charles Davies said in a statement that Liberty had been formally cautioned for not following current LOA procedures in connection with the introduction of payments made to brokers for administrative work.
"In the context of a changing environment surrounding commission regulation, the LOA has decided to review the relevant provisions of its Code of Conduct," he said.
The clash between the two led to the resignation in March of Liberty Life executive vice chairman Dorian Wharton-Hood as LOA chairman.
The dispute centered on commissions of 125 rand paid to brokers each time they used Liberty Life's needs analysis programme.
